reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Board abolished and duties merged
headings.reviewNote: Covers abolition of the board of barber examiners and merger into the board under section 329.015, conditioned on appointment and senate confirmation. Abolition contingent on appointment and senate confirmation.

headings.title: Transfer of powers to successor board
headings.reviewNote: Covers transfer of all powers, duties and functions to the board as successor, conditioned on appointment and confirmation.

headings.title: Effect of prior board acts
headings.reviewNote: Covers deemed force and effect of acts under the board, including amendments effective before August 28, 2005.

headings.title: Continuation and review of existing rules
headings.reviewNote: Covers continued effect of prior rules until revised, amended or repealed, plus the board's duty to review and adopt rules for barbers and cosmetologists.

headings.title: Existing licenses treated as board licenses
headings.reviewNote: Covers persons licensed or provisionally licensed before appointment and confirmation being considered licensed in the same manner.

headings.title: Barber apprentice registration, fees, and minimum age
headings.reviewNote: Covers apprentice application, registration, fees before starting, and the minimum age of seventeen. Title revised on review: adds fee payment before apprenticeship.

headings.title: Apprentice supervisor license requirements
headings.reviewNote: Covers prerequisites for supervising apprentices: barber license, application, fees, eight-hour board-certified course, and supervisor license.

headings.title: Board rules on apprentice supervision
headings.reviewNote: Covers the permissive ('may') authority to make rules on supervision and training criteria.

headings.title: Rulemaking compliance and nonseverability
headings.reviewNote: Covers chapter 536 conditions, section 536.028 if applicable, nonseverability, and invalidity if review powers are held unconstitutional; refers to rules after August 28, 2004.

headings.title: Examination, license, and admission qualifications
headings.reviewNote: Covers board examination, license issuance upon passing and fee, and the five admission findings (age, disease, training hours or apprenticeship, skill, knowledge).

headings.title: Board judgment of training sufficiency
headings.reviewNote: Covers the board as judge of whether a barber school, apprenticeship or college is properly conducted.

headings.title: Board determination of applicant qualifications
headings.reviewNote: Covers the full subsection text.

headings.title: Licensure without examination by reciprocity
headings.reviewNote: Covers two consecutive years practice elsewhere, fees, and the bar for licensees under disciplinary action with another board; cross-reference to section 324.009.

headings.title: Evaluation of out-of-state experience for examination
headings.reviewNote: Covers applicants who do not qualify without examination, board evaluation of training, notice of deficiencies.

headings.title: Reciprocity and evaluated-applicant fee
headings.reviewNote: Covers a fee equivalent to the barber examination fee for applicants under the section. Title revised on review: fee equals barber examination fee for subsection 1 and 2 applicants.

headings.title: Duty to apply for license renewal
headings.reviewNote: Covers every person engaged in barbering applying on or before the renewal date.

headings.title: Renewal contents, late fees, and reinstatement
headings.reviewNote: Covers expiring license number, renewal fee, reinstatement fee after two months, delinquent years up to two years, and practicum exam and fee between two and five years.

headings.title: Renewal fee after honorable military discharge
headings.reviewNote: Covers the one dollar renewal for honorably discharged licensees returning within one year of discharge. Title revised on review: source limits it to honorably discharged licensees returning within one year.

headings.title: Establishment licensing and sanitary compliance
headings.reviewNote: Covers license issuance on fee and sanitary compliance under section 329.025, continuing compliance, and complaint grounds for discipline.

headings.title: Establishment renewal, penalties, and posting
headings.reviewNote: Covers renewal, penalty fee after thirty days, delinquent fee for unlicensed new establishments, and posting.

headings.title: Barber school license renewal and late fee
headings.reviewNote: Covers renewal application and fee by renewal date and late fee.

headings.title: School course rules, revocation, and nondiscrimination
headings.reviewNote: Covers board rules on course of study, revocation for violations under chapter 621, and fair nondiscriminating licensing.

headings.title: Instructor-to-student ratio
headings.reviewNote: Covers not less than one teacher or instructor per fifteen students.

headings.title: Student registration with board
headings.reviewNote: Covers immediate filing of student name and age, register entry, and student registration fee.

headings.title: Certification of course completers
headings.reviewNote: Covers school certification of students completing at least one thousand hours over not less than six months.

headings.title: Rule effectiveness under section 536.024

headings.title: Board may refuse licenses; applicant notice
headings.reviewNote: Covers board refusal for causes in subsection 2, written reasons, and advice of right to complain to the administrative hearing commission under chapter 621. Title revised on review: refusal is permissive.

headings.title: Grounds for board complaint to hearing commission
headings.reviewNote: Covers the full subsection text. Title revised on review: complaint is permissive and reaches holders and lapsed or surrendered licensees.

headings.title: Discipline after commission finding; probation and suspension limits
headings.reviewNote: Covers chapter 621 proceedings and board options after finding: censure, probation up to five years, suspension up to three years, or revocation. Title revised on review: keeps permissive board action and the five-year/three-year limits.
